rawContent: Instead of falling for the “he keeps us safe” lie of would be dictators, we must remember  #wekeepussafe. The problems we face—from #climatechange to #coronavirus—require collaboration to solve. Only way we can take care of public safety is if we take care of the public.

Of course, @joebiden would be better than @realdonaldtrump but there is no return to normal in a burning house. We need real public infrastructure in the 21st century to survive the crisis we created let alone resolve them. #coronavirus #climatechange
